question: Compare Airbus’s 2025 climate report and Schneider Electric’s 2024 sustainability report on Scope 1 and 2 GHG reduction targets. What target does each report disclose?
ground_truth_answer: Airbus discloses an SBTi-approved, 1.5°C-aligned absolute emissions target that is organization-wide, covers CO2 in Scope 1 and Scope 2, ends on 12/31/2030, and targets a 63% reduction from the base year. Schneider Electric discloses AVEVA near-term targets to reduce absolute Scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions 90% by 2030 and absolute Scope 3 GHG emissions 50% by 2030 from a 2020 base year, plus long-term net-zero GHG emissions across the value chain by 2050.

Siemens’s 2019 report states that it planned to halve the footprint of its own operations by 2020 compared with 2014 and become carbon neutral by 2030, and that by fiscal 2019 it had reduced CO2 emissions by around 900,000 metric tons versus 2014.

question: Compare Schneider Electric’s 2024 sustainability report and Danone’s 2025 integrated report on water-related targets and progress.

Danone’s 2025 integrated report reports 99.3% progress on deploying the 4R approach in all production sites by 2030 and 71.9% progress on watershed preservation/restoration plans in operational sites located in highly water-stressed areas by 2030.

question: Compare Schneider Electric’s 2024 health and safety governance with ENGIE’s 2025 health and safety targets.

question: Compare L’Oréal’s 2024 annual report and Danone’s 2025 universal registration document on social inclusion and gender/diversity-related outcomes.
ground_truth_answer: L’Oréal’s 2024 annual report says its Inclusive Sourcing programme helped 106,000 socially and economically vulnerable people access employment, the L’Oréal Fund for Women helped more than 4.8 million women and girls since 2020, and Beauty for a Better Life provided vocational beauty training to over 20,000 vulnerable women across 21 countries in 2024. Danone’s 2025 universal registration document reports 2024 gender figures including 29,332 women employees out of 89,528 total employees, 44% women on the Board of Directors, 23% women on the Executive Committee, and 54% women among managers, senior managers and executives.

ground_truth: ENGIE’s 2025 sustainability report describes decarbonization levers including coal exit, renewables and storage, electricity networks, greening gas and green hydrogen; it reports 2024 achievements such as ~2 GW coal installed capacity, 51 GW renewable projects pipeline, 4.2 GW additional renewable capacity, and a coal phase-out commitment for 2025 in continental Europe and 2027 for the rest of the world. Schneider Electric’s 2024 sustainability report discloses AVEVA near-term targets to reduce absolute Scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions 90% by 2030 and absolute Scope 3 GHG emissions 50% by 2030 from a 2020 base year, plus long-term net-zero GHG emissions across the value chain by 2050.
